cause: The parameterized expected-file manifest appended the communicator after layernorm, while the image-side sha256sum command emitted communicator before layernorm. cmp rejected the line-order mismatch even though the expected hashes were correct.
corrective_action: Emit image-side hashes in the same deterministic order as the expected manifest and use a new R5 cache/evidence namespace.
reporting_boundary: No server startup, model load, request, or performance evidence occurred.
